summary: Financial risk and model-governance specialist targeting the Financial Risk Audit Manager, Vice President mandate at State Street, bringing ~7 years of independent review, effective challenge, and governance oversight across interest rate, liquidity, and market risk from the model-governance and practitioner side of institutional risk analytics. Holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement ($50bn+ cumulative), sits on a model governance committee, and escalates outputs lacking economic defensibility. CFA charterholder; dual MSc (Financial Modelling, Engineering).

sections.heading: Independent Review, Challenge & Sign-Off
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement ($50bn+ cumulative), independently reviewing curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions prior to production release.
Serve on the model governance committee, contributing to methodology review, documentation and benchmarking standards, and model-performance assessment for client-delivered analytics.
Escalate outputs lacking mathematical or economic defensibility and act as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues, engaging directly with clients' Heads of Risk.
Validate derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation, confirming consistency of sensitivities and scenario impacts at portfolio-level aggregates.

sections.heading: Interest Rate & Liquidity Risk Measurement
bullets: Oversee interest rate risk and duration analysis under parallel and non-parallel rate shocks, aligned with Basel-style IRRBB measurement standards.
Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash-flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios across ALM horizons.
Architected configurable time-bucketed liquidity gap analytics (T+1 through multi-year) supporting funding optimization and refinancing risk assessment.
Review aggregation logic converting security-level exposures into portfolio-level risk metrics feeding downstream ALM and capital processes.

sections.heading: Governance, Documentation & Stakeholder Reporting
bullets: Operate within a formal model-governance framework, building documentation and validation standards consistent with SR 11-7-style and OSFI E-23 regulatory expectations.
Prepare analytical summaries for senior stakeholders on interest rate exposure, scenario impacts, and balance-sheet sensitivities, translating technical results into committee-ready narratives.
Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable Python pipelines with embedded logging, validation, and auditability controls.

Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms on the PFaroe DB (risk & ALM) and PFaroe PM platforms, validating model outputs post-deployment.
Acted as technical liaison between client investment teams and product owners, translating risk and ALM configuration requirements into structured development requests.

roles.title: Senior Consultant - IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurers, aligning regulatory requirements with system implementation and financial-reporting frameworks.
Contributed to governance documentation and regulatory-readiness processes for financial institutions, advising actuarial, finance, IT, and risk functions on standard adoption.
Coordinated across actuarial, finance, IT, risk, and program-management teams on milestone delivery and implementation materials.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform, with risk decomposition and attribution to test robustness of allocation recommendations.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators assessing interest rate risk and funding volatility under base-case and stressed environments.
Delivered ALM studies for pension funds and institutional investors, analyzing funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance-sheet risk exposures.
Performed cash flow, liquidity, and hedging analysis across interest rate, inflation, and currency risk for international institutional clients.
Presented study findings and stress-testing conclusions to investment committees at Canadian pension-fund clients on-site.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
